report.summary: All 26 tests are errors at fixture setup, not assertion failures: the session-scoped base_url fixture starts uvicorn and it exits with code 1 before /health answers, so no test body ran. Start by running `python -m uvicorn app.main:app --port 8000` with the same interpreter and environment as the failing run to get the traceback, which the CI report does not include; check APP_DB_PATH/DB_PATH as the first suspect.

causes.title: Test app process exits on startup, so the session fixture aborts every test
causes.explanation: tests/conftest.py launches `python -m uvicorn app.main:app` as a subprocess and polls /health. If the process exits, _wait_until_up raises RuntimeError before any test runs, so every test that uses base_url (directly or through api, user, new_user, anon_api, other_api or the UI fixtures) errors at setup. The application code I read has no obvious startup bug, so the likely cause is the environment: most likely the database path (APP_DB_PATH or the tmp dir, opened by the module-level schema creation in app/main.py) or the interpreter/venv. The traceback is not in the report, because uvicorn stderr goes to the console and is not captured. The run is also from a Windows machine (C:/Users/IvanPosavec/...), while .github/workflows/tests.yml runs on ubuntu-latest, so the environment differs from CI. Every test fails the same way across both the api and ui suites, which points to a shared cause rather than individual tests.
evidence: tests/api/test_auth_api.py::test_register_returns_created_user: "RuntimeError: App exited early with code 1" raised at tests\conftest.py:35 (_wait_until_up), reached from base_url at tests\conftest.py:65
Popen args use sys.executable -m uvicorn app.main:app with cwd=ROOT and env DB_PATH=<tmp db or APP_DB_PATH> (tests/conftest.py:55-62)
app/main.py:57-58 runs `with db() as _conn: _conn.executescript(SCHEMA)` at import time, so an unopenable DB path makes the app exit during startup
The same 'App exited early with code 1' error appears for all 26 tests in both the api and ui suites
The totals line reports errors=26 and failures=0, so no test reached its assertions
causes.suggested_fix: Reproduce the startup failure by running `python -m uvicorn app.main:app --port 8000` in the same venv with the same DB_PATH/APP_DB_PATH values, and read the traceback. Fix the environment: make sure the venv has requirements-dev.txt installed, that APP_DB_PATH (if set) points to a writable file in an existing directory, and that the Python version matches CI (3.12). If the traceback shows a genuine app error at import time, reclassify this as a product_bug. Once the app starts, re-run the suite; no test changes are needed.
